scope: Already-open editor interaction and audio work; startup excluded.

electron.method: Two counterbalanced fresh-profile pairs: baseline1/current1, then current2/baseline2. Each profile has one first-use and two warm trials per operation. Native assets are identical; renderer/application runtime rebuilt from each revision. Default Speed preference verified in the real app. All four profiles passed completion, playhead, 64-clip and real gesture assertions.
limitations: Shared WSL host; other tasks were active and host load changed. Timings are observations, not individual-change attribution or stable percentage budgets.
Four warm observations per revision per operation do not estimate a population p95. First-use trials are reported separately.
Xvfb animation-frame gaps measure renderer scheduling, not GPU presentation FPS. Each timeline observation spans only three seconds.
Amplify DSP was not changed; its whole-operation variability indicates storage/renderer/host effects shared by the measured operations.

report.method: Actual Electron development app with freshly staged production renderer and real preload/SQLite/PCM path. First trial includes first-use processing engines; subsequent trials are warm. Capture click to dialog closed, success status, cleared waveform pending state, explicit successful canvas paint and two animation frames. Xvfb RAF gaps are a renderer responsiveness proxy, not GPU presentation FPS. Startup excluded.

results.operation: Active dense timeline scroll and hover
results.gesture: Trusted mouse sweeps and bidirectional wheel scrolling on a zoomed timeline with 64 clips
